neutral.EN: Got one. Who's next?
neutral.TL: Isa na. Sino'ng susunod?

neutral.EN: Dropped that one cold. Line 'em up.
neutral.TL: Bagsak ang isa. Ihanay ang susunod.

neutral.EN: That one's dead. Send another.
neutral.TL: Patay ang isang 'yon. Magpadala pa ng isa.

neutral.EN: Downed it. Who else wants some?
neutral.TL: Ibinagsak ko na. Sino pa may gusto?

neutral.EN: First down. Bring on the rest.
neutral.TL: Unang bagsak. Dalhin ang iba.

neutral.EN: Crushed that skull. Next target.
neutral.TL: Durog ang bungo. Susunod na target.

neutral.EN: Stay in the dirt. Next!
neutral.TL: Manatili ka sa lupa. Sunod!

neutral.EN: That one's history. Moving to the next.
neutral.TL: Burado na 'yon. Lilipat sa susunod.

neutral.EN: One less rotting bastard. Who's next?
neutral.TL: Bawas ang isang bulok. Sino susunod?

neutral.EN: Put it down hard. Step up if you dare.
neutral.TL: Ibinagsak nang malupit. Lumapit ang may tapang.

neutral.EN: Down. Give me another.
neutral.TL: Patay. May kasunod pa ba?

neutral.EN: Dropped. Bring them on.
neutral.TL: Bagsak. Dalhin niyo rito.

neutral.EN: Dead. Who's stepping up?
neutral.TL: Patay na. Sino'ng lalapit?

neutral.EN: Finished that one. Send the next.
neutral.TL: Tinapos ko 'yon. Ipadala ang kasunod.

neutral.EN: Downed. Keep feeding them to me.
neutral.TL: Bagsak. Iharap niyo lang sa akin.

neutral.EN: Cracked open. Next in line.
neutral.TL: Basag na. Susunod sa pila.

neutral.EN: That one's done. Give me another target.
neutral.TL: Tapos na ang isang 'yon. Bigyan pa ako ng target.

neutral.EN: Dead on the ground. Next one step forward.
neutral.TL: Patay sa lupa. Susunod lumapit.

neutral.EN: Flattened. Who's next to die?
neutral.TL: Pinitpit. Sino susunod na mamamatay?

neutral.EN: One down. Not even winded.
neutral.TL: Isang bagsak. Hindi man lang ako hinihingal.

neutral.EN: That's one. Keep them coming.
neutral.TL: Isa na. Sige, lapit pa.

neutral.EN: One less rotten. Keep 'em coming.
neutral.TL: Bawas ang isang bulok. Lapit lang.

neutral.EN: First blood. Line them up.
neutral.TL: Unang tama. Ihanay niyo sila.

neutral.EN: That's one down. I can do this all day.
neutral.TL: Isang bagsak na 'yan. Kaya ko 'to buong araw.

neutral.EN: Score one for us. Keep pushing.
neutral.TL: Puntos sa atin. Tuloy ang sugod.

neutral.EN: Count one dead. Come get some.
neutral.TL: Bilangin ang isang patay. Halika rito.

neutral.EN: That's one less mouth to feed. Next.
neutral.TL: Bawas ang isang kakain. Sunod.

neutral.EN: One crushed. Keep 'em coming my way.
neutral.TL: Durog ang isa. Papuntahin niyo rito.

neutral.EN: Downed one. Who wants the same?
neutral.TL: Nagpabagsak ng isa. Sino may gusto ng gano'n din?

neutral.EN: One in the grave. Keep them coming.
neutral.TL: Isa sa hukay. Sige, tuloy lang.
